Second Late_Blight reference also strongly matches — brown tan areas on leaf against gray background, very similar pattern to test image. Let me now check other classes before concluding.

Leaf_Mold shows pale spots on black background — doesn't match. Checking Septoria_Leaf_Blotch.
Septoria shows multiple small dark spots — doesn't match the test image. Checking Phytophthora_Blight.
Phytophthora_Blight shows a different pattern (water-soaked on larger leaf). Last class to check before concluding — Powdery_Mildew.

Powdery Mildew shows white powdery coating — not a match.

**Summary of visual comparisons:**
- **Late_Blight** (CDDM_498.jpg): extremely strong match — identical gray background, same layout of a tomato leaf with large tan-brown necrotic areas covering the leaf tip/upper portion while lower portion remains green
- **Late_Blight** (LeafNet_423.jpg): also strong match — same setting and browning pattern
- **Gray_Mold**: tan/brown areas match somewhat but lack the specific pattern
- **Early_Blight, Leaf_Mold, Septoria, Phytophthora_Blight, Powdery_Mildew**: all poor matches

The test image is most consistent with **Late_Blight** — large brown/tan necrotic patches on a tomato leaf against a gray surface, matching the CDDM dataset style and the characteristic large necrotic spread on the leaf.
